entries.note: Generated: an unobstructed head-on F-15EX from the marshalled photo beside it. Trusted for layout and proportions only: the intakes' width against the nose, the wing's span and level line, the fins' spacing and height, the gear track. Its stores (an AIM-120 on every station, odd fins) and fin-tip fairings are guesses. The gateway ignored the seed, so it does not reproduce.
entries.prompt: US Air Force Boeing F-15EX Eagle II, straight head-on front view at eye level on a runway in daylight, photographic reference. Two-seat tandem bubble canopy, long pointed grey radome, two large rectangular raked box intakes either side of the nose below the cockpit, high-mounted cropped-delta wing level with slight anhedral, twin vertical fins standing upright on the tail booms with the antenna fairings on their tips, all-moving stabilators below, tall tricycle landing gear with the nose gear centred, conformal fuel tanks along the intakes' flanks, AIM-120 missiles on the CFT stations and wing pylons, two-tone compass grey paint. Whole aircraft in frame, symmetric, no people, no text.
